text: This report summarizes the discussions at the Tenant Liaison Meeting held in person on November 26, 2024, at the Enercare Centre. Kelvin Seow, Chief People and Strategy Officer, led the meeting, co-hosted by Mr. Howard Lichtman member of the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place. Thirty tenant representatives and several Exhibition Place and City of Toronto staff were in attendance.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (January 21, 2025) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
